description:
`ai` answers an OpenAI chat request with the AI you've chosen as your AI preference: a `/p/llm` tier, or your own key.

The gateway rewrites `/ai/...` to your preference, the way it rewrites an `/a/<name>` alias, then routes it like any other call, streaming included. The preference can be a `/p/llm` tier, an LLM service from the marketplace, one of your enrollments (`e/<code>`, including BYOK), or one of your aliases, named by the service alone: a service is one model. With none set, `/ai` uses `labs/llm-balanced` (`/p/llm`, `model="balanced"`). A team key uses the team's own preference, or that default billed to the team, never a member's personal one. `ai` itself is free: each call is billed by the service it resolves to, at that service's own price.

Point any OpenAI-compatible client at `/ai` with your UnitySVC key, and set your AI under **Your AI** in Preferences (or `PUT /v1/preferences/ai`). Switch provider or model there, without changing the app.
name: ai

payout_price.description: No platform commission — each call is billed by the AI service it resolves to

summary: Send an OpenAI chat request to `/ai` and UnitySVC answers it with the AI you've chosen — a `/p/llm` tier or your own key — with no service or model to hard-code.
